read_range_subphases.9: Before scratch allocation; includes initial activity and parent validation before placement.
read_range_subphases.12: Before lookup_via_index_async await; reset11 before later cache insertion.
read_range_subphases.schema_scope: New phases9..13 accepted only for fixed operation4(read-file-range).
read_range_subphases.bounds: Same16slots,128attempts per selected measured launch,180s window,fourrecords per5s.
limitations: Static subphases mark entry boundaries, not CPU time or file paths.
Phase9 cannot distinguish scratch allocation from initial helper validation.
Clock reads occur only for active, nonexpired observed tickets; no-op and inactive paths read none.
Expired or absent rows never imply filesystem completion.
